Lina M.: Kicking off NimbleCart onboarding. Pilot goal: 6-week POC for receipts parsing + store lookup. Need stakeholders, owners, success metrics, and obvious blockers.

Omar V.: I'll own infra and the staging endpoint. Requesting cross-account read role or presigned S3 export.

Gabe R.: I'll run ML tuning and evals. If data is blocked by PCI we'll use synthetic receipts; need 200 examples or a confirmation to synth.

Tess (NimbleCart): Hi! We can provide masked receipts but security wants a checklist before upload. Renewal conversation depends on pilot delivering a quick internal demo.

Lina M.: Stakeholders: NimbleCart - Tess (product), Marco (security), Priya (ops). Redwood - Lina (CS), Omar (Infra), Gabe (ML), Rhea (Enablement).

Gabe R.: Draft success criteria:
- Extraction accuracy (total/date/vendor) >= 90% on labeled set
- Intent classification F1 >= 0.88
- p95 latency < 800ms under nominal load
- Ops: JSON schema validated >= 93%
- Adoption: 2 enablement sessions completed + runbook approved

Omar V.: Timeline suggestion:
- Week 0: access & staging endpoint (Omar)
- Week 1: baseline eval set + enablement (Gabe/Rhea)
- Week 2-4: tuning + pilot QA
- Week 5-6: pilot run & exec demo prep

SecBot: Automated: "NimbleCart PCI checklist" form created. Link: https://security.redwood.ai/forms/nimble-pci

Tess (NimbleCart): Marco will join a security call Tue 3pm PT.

Lina M.: Owners / immediate actions:
- Omar: provide staging endpoint or presigned link by Fri (owner)
- Gabe: prepare 200 labeled or synthetic receipts by Tue
- Rhea: schedule 2x60m enablement sessions week 1 and draft runbook by Wed
- Lina: set weekly syncs and coordinate security call

Omar V.: I'll post smoke-test URL once ready and include this cURL: ```curl -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"input":"parse receipt: \"Store: Pine, Total: $19.99, Date: 2024-02-10\""}'```

Gabe R.: If PCI blocks real data, I'll generate labeled synthetic receipts covering edge cases (multicurrency, discounts) by Tue.

Lina M.: Reconvene Fri 10am PT to confirm endpoint and dataset. Flagging renewal risk: if major blockers by week 3, we'll escalate to exec sponsor. Thanks all :handshake:
